  • Method Details

    • createTable

      public void createTable()
      Creates the game_sessions table if it does not already exist. The table records configuration, status, and balance data for each poker game session.

    • insert

      public int insert(User user, Game game, Player player)
      Inserts a new game session row and returns the generated session id.
      Parameters:
      user - the logged-in User starting the session
      game - the Game providing session configuration (difficulty, blind size, etc.)
      player - the human Player whose starting balance is recorded
      Returns:
      the generated session id, or -1 if the insert failed

    • finish

      public void finish(int sessionId, int endingBalance, String status)
      Updates an existing session row to mark it as finished with the user's final balance.
      Parameters:
      sessionId - the primary key of the session to finalise
      endingBalance - the user's chip balance at the end of the game
      status - the final status string (e.g. "ENDED")
